sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just one win in ten games. This should represent a comfortable home fixture for the in-form league leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table teams, with Stafford chasing the leaders after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in strong form, host Eccleshall in a clash between the third and fifth-placed sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and recently winning, entertain Wednesfield Community in another upper-table encounter. Bilston Town, sixth and unbeaten in their last three, visit Foley Meir (11th). Barnton (7th) face Shawbury United (15th), while New Mills (8th) travel to Market Drayton Town (10th) in a mid-table battle. Telford Town (18th) visit Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) in a bottom-half clash, and Widnes Town (bottom, pointless) visit Brereton Social (14th). Crewe (16th) host Allscott Heath (11th) in the remaining fixture.
